svg.title: Tiny GPT with one shared trunk and separate output heads
svg.desc: Tokens [64, 256] go through token and position embeddings, 8 pre-norm blocks (RMSNorm, causal self-attention, SwiGLU), a final RMSNorm, and into two linear heads: head 1 predicts token t+1 (loss L1), head 2 added in Part 2 predicts token t+2 (loss L2); loss = L1 + L2. Head 1 can be tied to tok_emb.
svg.text: RMSNorm → attention → + residual · RMSNorm → SwiGLU → + residual
